title: Finding this page gave me chills..
content: I've been going to the same mall/ school/event space in my dreams since before I can remember, every single night without missing a night. I have drawing of this place and know the names of the people. I actually have mild depression from it feeling more real than real life. The dreams in the last few weeks have had someone locking everyone in the mall and they had like magical powers or something. Also some times there is like explosions on the outside. I suck at typing but just had to say something.
